title: A Fortnight at the Little Vesper Theatre
blurb: The Little Vesper Theatre seats forty people and employs a company of puppeteers who will not be in the same room together.

text.intro:
The Little Vesper Theatre seats forty people and employs a company of puppeteers who will not be in the same room together.
Six puppeteers are involved. Determine each puppeteer's slot, puppet, play and accompaniment.
- **Puppeteer**: Bowen, Halima, Stellan, Mirabel, Josefa and Lorcan.
- **Running order** (listed from earlier to later): slot one, slot two, slot three, slot four, slot five and slot six.
- **Lead puppet**: a tin soldier, a shepherd boy, a drowned sailor, a moth queen, a brass magistrate and a one-eyed cat.
- **Play**: Six Spoons, Hollowmas, Marrowbone, The Clockwork Orchard, Winterling and The Drowned Bell.
- **Accompaniment**: a musical saw, a hurdy-gurdy, a bowed psaltery, a prepared piano, two kettle drums and a pump organ.
Every puppeteer has a different slot, puppet, play and accompaniment, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: The puppeteer who stages The Drowned Bell falls somewhere between slot five and slot one in slot order.
Slot two is exactly one slot earlier than the puppeteer who works a moth queen, with no slot in between.
The puppeteer who stages Winterling and Josefa are exactly five slots apart in slot order. The puppeteer who works a shepherd boy falls somewhere between Josefa and slot four in slot order.
Mirabel falls somewhere between the puppeteer who works a brass magistrate and slot two in slot order. The puppeteer who is accompanied by a musical saw does not work a brass magistrate.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The puppeteer who stages Six Spoons performs in slot three. (b) The puppeteer who stages Hollowmas and the puppeteer who works a one-eyed cat both sit at odd-numbered slots or both at even-numbered slots.
Slot three falls somewhere between the puppeteer who is accompanied by a prepared piano and Halima in slot order.
The puppeteer who is accompanied by a pump organ and slot two are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.
The puppeteer who is accompanied by two kettle drums and slot four are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.
The puppeteer who is accompanied by a prepared piano falls somewhere between Lorcan and slot one in slot order.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The puppeteer who is accompanied by a hurdy-gurdy is earlier than the puppeteer who stages The Clockwork Orchard in slot order. (b) The puppeteer who is accompanied by a bowed psaltery is later than slot five in slot order.

If (a) holds then (b) also holds, but not necessarily the reverse: (a) The puppeteer who is accompanied by a bowed psaltery is later than slot five in slot order. (b) The puppeteer who is accompanied by a pump organ and the puppeteer who stages The Clockwork Orchard are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.
The puppeteer who is accompanied by a hurdy-gurdy and slot three both sit at odd-numbered slots or both at even-numbered slots.
The puppeteer who stages The Clockwork Orchard does not work a brass magistrate.

If (a) holds then (b) also holds, but not necessarily the reverse: (a) The puppeteer who is accompanied by a prepared piano and the puppeteer who works a one-eyed cat are exactly two slots apart in slot order. (b) The puppeteer who is accompanied by a pump organ works a moth queen.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The puppeteer who works a moth queen is earlier than Bowen in slot order. (b) The puppeteer who is accompanied by a bowed psaltery stages Six Spoons.
One of the puppeteer who is accompanied by a hurdy-gurdy and the puppeteer who stages Hollowmas sits at an odd-numbered slot and the other at an even-numbered slot.
Josefa is exactly one slot earlier than the puppeteer who stages Marrowbone, with no slot in between.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The puppeteer who works a one-eyed cat and Stellan are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other. (b) The puppeteer who stages The Clockwork Orchard works a moth queen.
The puppeteer who works a tin soldier is earlier than the puppeteer who is accompanied by two kettle drums in slot order.
